description: MiniLM sentence embedding retrieval over the full 3500-document corpus.
SQLite FTS5 BM25F-style file search with chunk/document aggregation and title/exact anchors.
Entity-document graph path retrieval using entity extraction, sentence/title links, and beam search.
Rule-based first-stage selector that chooses one core retriever from query signals.
RRF fusion over all three core retrievers; fixed three calls per question.
Analysis-only ideal selector using gold labels during evaluation; not deployable.
Final two-stage agent with coverage-based Evidence Judge and protected weighted RRF.
